roles.scope: development-scaled; development patients reused across runs

mass_weighted_coverage_deficit.note: Worst column 'diag_1': share of reference patients whose category is absent from the synthetic table, minus the same share for the real floor (synthetic 0.9865; floor 0.9886).

detection_auc.threshold: lower bound > floor upper bound + 0.05 -> Conditional (Fail requires null calibration)
detection_auc.note: Cross-fitted gradient-boosting classifier two-sample test against the held-out real reference; real-vs-real floor AUC 0.503.

pmse_ratio_to_real_floor.note: Propensity-score MSE divided by the real-vs-real pMSE (empirical null; 1 = like real).

worst_column_normalized_wasserstein.note: Worst continuous column 'number_emergency' (reported so a column average cannot hide one broken variable); floor 0.0267.

synthetic_retention_random_forest.note: Chance-corrected AUROC retention versus the same probe trained on real training data.

real_reference_retention_random_forest.note: Chance-corrected AUROC retention versus the same probe trained on real training data. Positive control: an independent real sample; should be near 1.

synthetic_retention_logistic_regression.note: Chance-corrected AUROC retention versus the same probe trained on real training data.

real_reference_retention_logistic_regres.note: Chance-corrected AUROC retention versus the same probe trained on real training data. Positive control: an independent real sample; should be near 1.

synthetic_retention_gradient_boosting.note: Chance-corrected AUROC retention versus the same probe trained on real training data.

real_reference_retention_gradient_boosti.note: Chance-corrected AUROC retention versus the same probe trained on real training data. Positive control: an independent real sample; should be near 1.

probe_agreement.note: Primary verdict is the v0.3 random forest; a primary Pass becomes Conditional only if another probe confidently Fails (probe-dependent utility).

relative_calibration_in_the_large.note: Observed/expected events of the synthetic-trained logistic probe on real test data, divided by the real-trained value (1.001).

relative_calibration_slope.note: Calibration slope of the synthetic-trained logistic probe divided by the real-trained slope (0.737).

exact_training_duplicate_rate.note: Exact-match count against plug-in E-in-T coincidence rate 0; all T rows used.

median_distance_to_closest_training_reco.note: Median standardized mixed-feature distance to the closest real training row; estimated with 10,000 synthetic queries against 10,000 real references; descriptive only, not a privacy guarantee.

share_closer_than_real_real_floor.note: Share of synthetic rows closer to training data than the fifth percentile of non-self real-to-real distances in the bounded distance sample.

nearest_neighbor_distance_ratio_p05.note: Fifth percentile of closest-to-second-closest distance ratio; low values identify unusually isolated matches.

distance_membership_attack_auc.threshold: Provisional: lower 95% bound > 0.55 -> Fail; upper 95% bound <= 0.55 -> Pass; otherwise Conditional
distance_membership_attack_auc.note: Black-box distance attack: candidate closeness to released synthetic data predicts membership in real training versus held-out real data; members n=10,000, nonmembers n=10,000, released rows n=10,000.

distance_membership_attack_tpr_at_1pct_f.note: Exploratory weak lower-bound attack; requires >= 100 nonmembers for FPR resolution; no low-FPR CI.

exact_match_binomial_pvalue.note: Plug-in null; uncertainty in p0 is not integrated.

distance_membership_attack_tpr_at_0_1pct.note: Exploratory weak lower-bound attack; requires >= 1000 nonmembers for FPR resolution; no low-FPR CI.

threat_model.attacker_knowledge: released synthetic table and a candidate record
threat_model.attacker_access: black-box access to released rows; no generator access
threat_model.attacker_goal: infer whether the candidate was in real_train
threat_model.attack: distance to closest released synthetic row
threat_model.interpretation: Empirical risk under this attacker only; not a formal privacy guarantee.

warnings: Nearest-neighbor exposure was estimated from reproducible bounded samples (real reference n=10,000; synthetic query n=10,000). Exact-copy analysis still used all rows.

worst_group_retention.note: Minimum over decision-eligible groups; unavailable if any eligible group has weak TRTR.

subgroup_results.note: Paired subgroup E-row bootstrap; chance-corrected against subgroup TRTR.

relative_calibration_slope.note: Calibration slope of the synthetic-trained logistic probe divided by the real-trained slope (0.737).

worst_group_retention.note: No fully evaluable eligible subgroup set.

v04.scope: provisional v0.4.1; gate over fidelity, utility and privacy; equity and robustness are non-gating diagnostics; calibration is a separate saved-evidence wrapper

sdmetrics.native_missingness_policy: Native SDMetrics headline retained; omitted property scores recorded explicitly.
